messages.content: Get the protein sequence of human HbA1c, normal hemoglobin, and rat hemoglobin and their 3D models

So we can just use "Hemoglobin subunit beta" for human. For normal hemoglobin, we can use "Hemoglobin subunit alpha" and "Hemoglobin subunit beta".
